problem.text: ComboSampler defaults min_p to zero, but its nonzero-temperature branch constructed SS_MinP(0), which rejected zero with an assertion.

reasoning.text: The patch changes the accepted interval from (0, 1] to [0, 1) and makes zero select SS_NoOp through the existing alternative-step mechanism.

impact.text: This removes the default ComboSampler min-p construction failure. Positive values below one retain their existing filtering behavior; exactly one now fails validation when assertions are enabled.

source_notes.text: The earlier zero-temperature entry recorded the default min-p failure as persisting on the nonzero-temperature path.

PR #30, “fix: don't add min_p and top_p samplers to stack if falsy,” reports assertions for zero-valued min_p and top_p. Its relationship to this change is inferred from the matching min_p assertion, not an explicit upstream link. The task changes min-p only, using step substitution rather than the omission proposed by the PR title.

limitations: No repository sampler, PyTorch operation or GPU kernel was executed. The scalar check models predicates and filtering with Python numbers, not tensor precision or sampled-token equivalence.

chapters.title: Zero min-p as a neutral sampling step

claims.text: CustomSampler calls alt() before prep(). Replacing zero-valued min-p with SS_NoOp therefore avoids both min-p's normalization prerequisite and its masking operation. The no-op leaves sampling state unchanged; it remains in the step list rather than being deleted.

Active min-p retains probabilities greater than or equal to min_p times the largest probability. Unsorted normalized input uses a row maximum; sorted normalized input uses its first column. Masking marks the result unnormalized while preserving whether it is sorted.

Zero represents no relative probability cutoff. One would retain only maximum-probability candidates, including ties, but is now excluded by the constructor. The patch supplies no explanation for excluding this endpoint.

A scalar transcription verified the changed endpoint predicates. For probabilities [0.6, 0.3, 0.1], a min-p fraction of 0.5 produces threshold 0.3 and retains the first two values, demonstrating inclusive threshold comparison.
ComboSampler's zero-temperature branch already bypasses min-p entirely. DefaultSampler continues using 0.08, so its construction and filtering are unchanged.

annotation.summary: Accepts zero min-p as a no-op, fixing default ComboSampler construction, and excludes the previously accepted endpoint of one.

argv:
import json
ps=[-0.1,0.0,0.08,0.5,1.0,1.1]
p=[0.6,0.3,0.1]
print(json.dumps({'bounds':[{'min_p':m,'old':0<m<=1,'new':0<=m<1,'no_op':m==0} for m in ps], 'mask_examples':[{'min_p':m,'threshold':max(p)*m,'retained':[v for v in p if v>=max(p)*m]} for m in [0,0.5,1]]}))
